# PHAROS CLI — agent command reference (docs/llm.txt)
# Generated by 'pharos llmtxt' from the Cobra command tree. Do not edit by
# hand; regenerate with 'go generate ./...' (or 'pharos llmtxt').
#
# Environment contract (honored by every command):
#   PHAROS_NON_INTERACTIVE=1  never launch an interactive prompt or TUI;
#                             every command has a non-interactive path.
#   PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1       answer "yes" to confirmation prompts, including
#                             destructive ones (init, purge, unpublish).
#   PHAROS_JSON=1             emit machine-parsable JSON on stdout for every
#                             command that has a --json flag (same output as
#                             passing --json).
# Values: unset/empty = false; "1"/"true"/"yes" (case-insensitive) = true;
# anything else ("0", "false", "no", garbage) = false — liberal, never an
# error.
# Guarantees:
#   1. Every command completes without a terminal given its required args.
#   2. Commands with --json emit valid JSON on stdout.
#   3. If a command would need an interactive answer in non-interactive mode,
#      it exits 1 with an error naming the flag that fixes it (e.g. "init
#      requires --yes or PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1 in non-interactive mode").
# Human-facing docs: README.md. Generated: this file.

# COMMAND: pharos
SHORT: PHAROS — MCP server package registry CLI
USAGE: pharos [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for pharos
  --version <bool> (default: false) version for pharos
SUBCOMMANDS: audit, completion, config, daemon, doctor, health, help, import, info, init, install, list, llmtxt, lock, login, oauth, package, publish, purge, remove, republish, search, start, stop, unpublish, update, version, whoami
OUTPUT: help text listing subcommands
ENV: all three contract vars are inherited by every subcommand
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; safe by default

# COMMAND: pharos audit
SHORT: Scan installed servers for known security vulnerabilities
USAGE: pharos audit [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for audit
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
OUTPUT: JSON: {total_servers, scanned, vulnerable_servers, entries: [{server, version, advisories, error}], has_vulnerabilities}; exit code 1 when vulnerabilities are found. Plain: per-server report
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; requires registry access

# COMMAND: pharos config

USAGE: pharos config <key> [value] [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for config
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
SUBCOMMANDS: add-client, list-clients, remove-client
OUTPUT: JSON get: {key, value} (value is "" when unset); JSON set: {key, value, saved: true}. Plain: "key: value" / "✓ key = value"
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts

# COMMAND: pharos config add-client
SHORT: Register a custom MCP client for auto-detection
USAGE: pharos config add-client <id> --path <path> [--format mcpServers|array] [flags]
FLAGS:
  --format <string> (default: mcpServers) config format: mcpServers or array
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for add-client
  --path <string> (default: ) absolute path to the client's MCP config file (required)
OUTPUT: single confirmation line; JSON N/A (single-line output)
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; --path is required

# COMMAND: pharos daemon autostart
SHORT: Enable or disable daemon autostart on boot
USAGE: pharos daemon autostart [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for autostart
  --off <bool> (default: false) disable autostart on boot
  --on <bool> (default: false) enable autostart on boot
OUTPUT: single status line, or enable/disable confirmation with --on/--off; JSON N/A (single-line output)
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; --on/--off run the platform service manager

# COMMAND: pharos import
SHORT: Import existing MCP server configs into a pharos.lock
USAGE: pharos import [flags]
FLAGS:
  --as-unmanaged <bool> (default: false) track unresolved servers without dropping them
  --client <string> (default: ) import from a specific client only (claude-desktop, cursor, generic)
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for import
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
OUTPUT: JSON: {lockfile, resolved, unresolved, servers: [{name, version, status}]}. Plain: per-server report + summary line
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; requires registry access to resolve servers

# COMMAND: pharos init
SHORT: Create a pharos.json manifest in the current directory
USAGE: pharos init [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for init
  --yes <bool> (default: false) accept all defaults non-interactively
OUTPUT: writes pharos.json (and .gitignore if absent) + confirmation lines; JSON N/A
ENV: PHAROS_NON_INTERACTIVE aborts with guidance unless the fix below is set; PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1 accepts all defaults
NON-INTERACTIVE: --yes, or PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1 (writes the default manifest: my-mcp-server@0.1.0, stdio, node)

# COMMAND: pharos install
SHORT: Download and install an MCP server package
USAGE: pharos install <name>[@version] [flags]
ALIASES: i
FLAGS:
  --client <string> (default: ) write config only to these clients (comma-separated: cursor,claude-desktop,claude-code,generic)
  --frozen <bool> (default: false) install strictly from lockfile; refuse if missing or mismatched
  --global <bool> (default: false) install system-wide
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for install
  --idle-timeout <int> (default: 60) idle timeout in minutes before auto-unloading (0 = never unload, always on)
  --no-dep-config <bool> (default: false) don't write MCP client configs for dependencies
  --select-clients <bool> (default: false) interactively pick which MCP clients to configure
  --version <string> (default: ) version or range to install (e.g. 1.2.0, ^1.0.0, latest)
OUTPUT: progress lines + per-client config write results; JSON N/A
ENV: PHAROS_NON_INTERACTIVE makes the --select-clients picker return the detected defaults instead of launching its TUI
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts by default (writes all detected clients); use --client to pin targets

# COMMAND: pharos list
SHORT: List locally installed packages
USAGE: pharos list [flags]
ALIASES: ls
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for list
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON (kind, status, endpoint, metrics)
  --running <bool> (default: false) show only running servers
  --sort <string> (default: name) sort by: name, size, port, memory, uptime
OUTPUT: JSON: array of {name, version, transport, kind, status, endpoint, port, size, memory, uptime, idle, lastActivity} ([] when none installed). Plain: table
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts

# COMMAND: pharos login
SHORT: Authenticate with the PHAROS registry via GitHub OAuth
USAGE: pharos login [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for login
  --manual <bool> (default: false) paste token manually instead of browser flow
OUTPUT: browser-flow URL + success line; token stored in ~/.pharos/credentials.json; JSON N/A
ENV: PHAROS_NON_INTERACTIVE aborts the browser flow with guidance instead of blocking on the OAuth callback
NON-INTERACTIVE: --manual (token on stdin), or skip login entirely with 'pharos config token <token>'

# COMMAND: pharos oauth configure
SHORT: Configure OAuth for a published MCP server
USAGE: pharos oauth configure <server-name> [flags]
FLAGS:
  --auth-url <string> (default: ) OAuth authorization server URL
  --client-id <string> (default: ) OAuth client ID
  --client-secret <string> (default: ) Client secret (for server-side secret handling)
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for configure
  --pkce <bool> (default: true) Require PKCE (default: true)
  --scopes <string> (default: ) Comma-separated OAuth scopes
OUTPUT: configuration confirmation lines; JSON N/A
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; --auth-url and --client-id are required

# COMMAND: pharos publish
SHORT: Publish a package to the PHAROS registry
USAGE: pharos publish [dir] [flags]
FLAGS:
  --dry-run <bool> (default: false) validate without publishing
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for publish
  --token <string> (default: ) auth token (overrides config)
OUTPUT: 4-phase progress lines (manifest, package, upload, publish) + confirmation; JSON N/A
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; use --dry-run to validate offline; requires --token or a stored token

# COMMAND: pharos purge
SHORT: Permanently remove a package version from the registry
USAGE: pharos purge <name> [flags]
FLAGS:
  --all <bool> (default: false) purge ALL versions
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for purge
  --version <string> (default: ) version to purge (e.g. 0.2.0)
  --yes <bool> (default: false) skip confirmation prompt
OUTPUT: per-version purge confirmations + final note; JSON N/A
ENV: PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1 skips the destructive confirmation; PHAROS_NON_INTERACTIVE without it aborts with guidance (destructive commands are never guessed)
NON-INTERACTIVE: --yes, or PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1

# COMMAND: pharos remove
SHORT: Remove an installed MCP server
USAGE: pharos remove <name> [flags]
ALIASES: rm, uninstall
FLAGS:
  --force <bool> (default: false) Force removal even if other packages depend on it
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for remove
OUTPUT: per-target removal confirmations; exit 1 when the server is unknown or dependency-protected; JSON N/A
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; use --force to override dependency protection

# COMMAND: pharos republish
SHORT: Re-activate a previously unpublished package version
USAGE: pharos republish <name> [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for republish
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
  --version <string> (default: ) version to republish (e.g. 0.2.0)
OUTPUT: JSON: {name, version, status: "active"}. Plain: single confirmation line
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; --version is required

# COMMAND: pharos search
SHORT: Search the PHAROS registry for packages
USAGE: pharos search <query> [flags]
ALIASES: s
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for search
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
  --limit <int> (default: 10) number of results
  --page <int> (default: 1) page number
  --registry <string> (default: ) filter by source registry (e.g. mcp.io, pharos)
  --transport <string> (default: ) filter by transport (e.g. stdio, http-sse)
OUTPUT: JSON: registry search response {results: [...], nextCursor, total}; each result also carries the trust signals publisher (flattened namespace string), category, tools_count, version_status when the registry sends them. Plain: results table (NAME VERSION TRANSPORT REGISTRY OWNER CATEGORY DESCRIPTION DOWNLOADS; version_status shown as a " (stale)"-style suffix only when not "active") + hint footer
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; requires registry access

# COMMAND: pharos start
SHORT: Start a locally installed MCP server
USAGE: pharos start <name> [flags]
FLAGS:
  --env <stringArray> (default: []) environment variable KEY=VALUE (repeatable)
  --foreground <bool> (default: false) run in foreground (block terminal, Ctrl+C to stop)
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for start
  --port <int> (default: 0) override declared port (http-sse only)
OUTPUT: started confirmation lines (PID, port, log path); informational refusals for stdio/remote servers; JSON N/A
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts

# COMMAND: pharos stop
SHORT: Stop a running MCP server
USAGE: pharos stop <name> [flags]
FLAGS:
  --all <bool> (default: false) stop all running Pharos-managed servers
  --force <bool> (default: false) send SIGKILL if SIGTERM doesn't stop within timeout
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for stop
  --timeout <int> (default: 5) seconds to wait for graceful shutdown
OUTPUT: single stop confirmation per server; JSON N/A (single-line output)
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts

# COMMAND: pharos unpublish
SHORT: Hide a package version from search and direct lookup
USAGE: pharos unpublish <name> [flags]
FLAGS:
  --all <bool> (default: false) unpublish ALL versions
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for unpublish
  --version <string> (default: ) version to unpublish (e.g. 0.2.0)
  --yes <bool> (default: false) skip confirmation prompt
OUTPUT: per-version confirmations + final note; JSON N/A
ENV: PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1 skips the confirmation; PHAROS_NON_INTERACTIVE without it aborts with guidance
NON-INTERACTIVE: --yes, or PHAROS_ASSUME_YES=1

# COMMAND: pharos update
SHORT: Check for and apply updates to installed MCP servers
USAGE: pharos update [name] [flags]
FLAGS:
  --dry-run <bool> (default: false) show what would change without applying updates
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for update
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
OUTPUT: JSON: {dry_run, updated, up_to_date, not_found, updates_available, servers: [{name, from, to, action}]} where action is one of updated, up_to_date, update_available, not_found, failed. Plain: per-server lines + summary
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; requires registry access

# COMMAND: pharos whoami
SHORT: Display the currently authenticated user
USAGE: pharos whoami [flags]
FLAGS:
  --help <bool> (default: false) help for whoami
  --json <bool> (default: false) output as JSON
OUTPUT: JSON: the authenticated user object (sub, namespace, scope, github_id, email, avatar_url, namespaces). Plain: labeled user lines; exit 1 when not logged in
ENV: PHAROS_JSON=1 or --json
NON-INTERACTIVE: no prompts; requires credentials + registry access
